chapterInfo.content:
7
Nkwa afono Hiob
1 # Hiob 14.6 Ɛnyɛ akodie na ɛwɔ hɔ ma ɔdasani asase soɔ
na ne nna te sɛ ɔpaani nna?
2Sɛ akoa pere onwunu ho
ne sɛ ɔpaani hwɛ n’apaadeɛ kwan no,
3saa ara na wɔama madi abosome hunu,
na wɔabu ɔhaw anadwo ama me.
4Sɛ mekɔda a, meka sɛ:
Da bɛn na mɛsɔreɛ na anadwo atwam akorɔ?
Ɔdafatwa fono me kɔsi ahemadakye.
5Me honam fira mmoaa ne dɔteɛ abon,
me wedeɛ ayɛ twann, na ɛrefiri nsuo.
6 # Yes 38.12 Me nna yɛ hare sene ɔnwomfoɔ akurokurowa,
na ɛrehi, na anidasoɔ biara nni hɔ.
7Kae sɛ me nkwa yɛ mframa,
m’ani rensane nhunu papa.
8Deɛ ɔhu me ani renhu me bio,
w’ani tua me, nso na menni hɔ.
9Sɛdeɛ mununkum sa na ɛkorɔ no,
saa ara na deɛ ɔsiane kɔ Asamando no remforo mma bio.
10 # Hiob 10.21; 14.10-12; 16.22; Dwom 103.16 Ɔrensane mma ne fie bio,
na ne tenabea renhu no bio.
11Enti me nso meremmua m’ano,
mɛkasa me honhom ahohiahia mu,
mɛsi apini m’awerɛhoɔ mu.
12Meyɛ ɛpo anaa asuo mu bɔpɔn,
na ɛma wode awɛmfoɔ sisi me ho yi?
13Sɛ mese: Me mpa bɛkyekyere me werɛ,
na me daberɛ bɛdwodwo m’apinisie no a,
14ɛnneɛ wode daeɛso hyɛ me yea,
na anisoadehunu mu na woma mebɔ binim.
15Na ɛma me kra yi menebɔ ne owuo mmom
sene me nnompe yi.
16 # 1 Ah 19.4 Afono me, merentena ase daa.
Gyaa me, na me nna yɛ huruhuro.
17 # Hiob 14.1-5; Dwom 8.4 Ɔdasani ne hwan a wobu no ɔkɛseɛ,
na wodwene ne ho?
18Na wohwɛ no daa anɔpa,
na wotaa sɔ no hwɛ ara?
19Worenyi w’ani mfiri me so de rekɔsi da bɛn?
Wonnya me kwan na memmene me ntasuo mpo?
20Mayɛ bɔne a, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ, nnipa hwɛfoɔ,
adɛn na wode me ayɛ w’adeɛ
a wo ne no anya na madane adesoa ama me ho yi?
21Na adɛn na womfa me mmarato nkyɛ,
na womma me mfomsoɔ nsene nkorɔ?
Na afei mɛda mfuturo mu,
na wobɛhwehwɛ me, nso na menni hɔ bio.

Me honam fira mmoaa ne dɔteɛ abon,

Afono me, merentena ase daa.

Mayɛ bɔne a, ɛdeɛn na mayɛ woɔ, nnipa hwɛfoɔ,

a wo ne no anya na madane adesoa ama me ho yi?
Na adɛn na womfa me mmarato nkyɛ,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
